about_the_game:
A lost brother. A cursed VHS format. A government cover-up.

Video Ghastlies is a survival horror game that takes you on a nightmarish journey through iconic eras of film. Set in 1990s Scotland, you play as a desperate sibling searching for their missing brother who was last seen obsessing over a mysterious VHS format. Dive into the tapes, fight your way through cinematic worlds, and find your brother before it’s too late.

Survive the cursed tapes

Your apartment is the hub. Here you can review clues, catch your breath, and prepare for the journey ahead. Use the Television set and insert VHS tapes to open the door to new worlds, each one with its own inspiration. Search for clues and face the nightmares in universes inspired by Silent Era Cinema, Italian Giallo films, 80s Body Horror, Found Footage and more.

Classic Film meets Survival Horror 

  • Scavenge and Solve: Search for supplies to stay alive and uncover key items to solve puzzles, unlocking your path forward.

  • Unusual Arsenal: Arm yourself with weapons and tools inspired by the film worlds you’ll explore.

  • Live-Action Video: Discover eerie VHS footage that blurs the line between fiction and reality.

  • Classic Survival Design: Your apartment is the only place you can save the game. Find shortcuts and new paths to progress on your journey.

  • Survive Twisted Worlds: Each world comes with its own enemies, puzzles, and bosses to defeat. 

Banned for a reason

Watching these tapes is dangerous. Some things aren’t meant to be recorded… and now, they’re watching you back. 

About the Developer

Chris Evry (Katanalevy) is a Scottish solo developer drawn to creating experiences that are a blend of the darkly visceral and gothic sublime. He is the creator of Cardiac, Symphony of Seven Souls and Daemonologie.

content_descriptors.notes: Violence against monsters within the tape areas of the game. The player has to travel within sub sections from the hub to fight and kill monsters. This is a survival horror game, with 80s slasher movie inspiration.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 3 2200G / Intel i5-7400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 570 / Nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 7 2700X / Intel i7-9700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 5070 / Nvidia 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Video Ghastlies is a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".
